units.source_text: 不久，K就找到了满意的工作。

en.t: Before long, K found a job that satisfied him.

units.source_text: 可是，对于惜时如金的K来说，这个工作有多么辛苦是不难想象的。

en.t: But for K, who valued time as if it were gold, it is not hard to imagine how exhausting that work must have been.

units.source_text: 他一如既往地努力学习，同时又背上了新的重负，勇武向前。

en.t: He kept studying as hard as ever, while taking on this new burden and pressing boldly ahead.

units.source_text: 我很担心他的身体，而刚强的他只是一笑置之，全然不理会我的劝告。

en.t: I was very worried about his health, but strong-willed as he was, he merely laughed it off and paid no attention to my advice.

units.source_text: 与此同时，他和养父家的关系也变得越来越复杂了。

en.t: At the same time, his relationship with his adoptive family also grew more and more complicated.

units.source_text: 时间很紧张的K，就连以前那样跟我说话的时间也被剥夺了，

en.t: K, pressed for time, was deprived even of the time he used to spend talking with me,

units.source_text: 所以我一直没能了解事情的详细经过，只知道情况变得越来越复杂。

en.t: so I never managed to learn the details of what had happened, and only knew that the situation was becoming increasingly complicated.

units.source_text: 我还听说有人居中进行了调解，那个人写信催促K回家，K却说回去没有用，不予理会。

en.t: I also heard that someone had stepped in to mediate, and that this person wrote urging K to return home, but K said there was no point in going back and ignored the request.

units.source_text: 尽管K声称学习期间不能回去，没有办法，但在对方看来，是K太顽固吧。

en.t: Although K insisted that he could not go home during the school term and that there was nothing to be done, from their side he must have seemed far too stubborn.

units.source_text: 这样，事态变得更加严重了。

en.t: In this way, the situation became even more serious.

units.source_text: 他不但伤害了养父的感情，同时也惹恼了自己的父亲。

en.t: He not only hurt his adoptive father's feelings, but also angered his own father.

units.source_text: 当我感到不安，写信给他们想要进行调解的时候，已经不起任何作用了。

en.t: By the time I grew uneasy and wrote to them in an attempt to mediate, it no longer had any effect.

units.source_text: 我的信石沉大海，一句回音都没有。

en.t: My letter disappeared without a trace, and not a single reply came back.

units.source_text: 我也生气了，我原本就对K抱有同情，决意今后纵然蛮不讲理，也要站在K一方。

en.t: I became angry too, and since I had already felt sympathy for K, I resolved that from then on I would stand on his side, even if it meant being unreasonable.
